name: Pandit Dindayal Upadhyay Awas Yojana (Developing Caste Welfare) (NT-DNT)
benefit: - **Financial Assistance:** Up to ₹1,20,000/- for house construction.
_eligibility_text:
- Applicant must be a resident of Gujarat.
  - Applicant must belong to the [Nomadic Tribe (NT)/ Denotified Tribe (DNT)](https://socialjustice.gov.in/writereaddata/UploadFile/Draft%20List%20of%20Denotified%20Tribes%20for%20Mail.pdf).  - Applicant’s annual family income must not exceed ₹6,00,000/-.
